motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. Chat messages highlight subtly. Buttons press down physically (Brutalist shadow reduction).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color hex codes in this guideline, do not use default Tailwind slates/grays. We are using custom tinted deep blacks (#050505, #0E0E11, #18181B) to simulate a premium editorial environment.
Do NOT use typical Discord UI styling (no Blurple, no full circles for servers). Use sharp edges, square/slightly rounded shapes (rounded-sm or rounded-none) for a brutalist feel.
All interactive elements must have the 'data-testid' attribute for testing.
Implement the Layout architecture strictly using Tailwind flexbox/grid.
Use JetBrains Mono for all body text, UI labels, and chat messages to give it a precise, developer-focused, technical feel. Import this font via index.css and extend it in Tailwind configuration.
Use Outfit for large headings, app brand, and usernames to inject high fashion/editorial contrast. Import this via index.css.
No generic full-screen gradients. Apply the noise/grain via CSS or transparent overlay on top of the hero image.
Use framer-motion for smooth micro-interactions on the server rail and modal states.
For Server Icons, if no image is provided, use CSS to render a stylized text initials avatar (e.g., 'C') with a dark base and orange border on hover.
Use .js files for React components as required.
